hooks.command: uv run python -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy, sys; p=Path.cwd().resolve(); rel=Path('scripts/hooks/precompact.py'); root=next((x for x in [p,*p.parents] if (x/rel).is_file()), None); assert root is not None, f'FCC script not found: {rel}'; sys.path.insert(0, str((root/rel).parent)); runpy.run_path(str(root/rel), run_name='__main__')"
